notes.title: March update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/e9644cf2e8fc906ccff74280cdd1af5cd0f55759.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

March update:

- We have corrected the achievements, now they are unlocked at the end of the level through the Steam Overlay.
- We have corrected a bug in the total deaths and jumps counters that caused them to not reset when deleting the game.
- We have fixed a bug in the last level where both collectibles were not counted correctly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png


Remember that if you find a bug or want to give us some type of feedback, you can do so through the following email: linghungame@gmail.com

From the Ling Hun Project team we want to thank you for all your support and positivity towards the project and we want to announce that we will continue working on it until it is completely polished.

- The Ling Hun Project team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/d8bff02654fa6ca5e1e776fc45eb1b613e5ead01.png

notes.title: Ling Hun receives Soundtrack
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

At Ling Hun Project we are proud to announce the release of the Ling Hun Soundtrack. For all those who have enjoyed the game and want to support our project a little more, discounted store packs or the soundtrack are available separately.
We thank Gerard Montero Selllares, who has created the entire game's music and, being a professional in music production, has shown that he is capable of facing practically any challenge and that thanks to his efforts, Ling Hun has an original soundtrack with a lot of Asian character. .


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/d499df970d87cb078d539b1d68b248e3d68d2953.png


Again, thanks to all of you who support the game and want to continue supporting it.
From the Ling Hun Project team we are always trying to improve the quality and polish of our game to bring you, players, the best of our creation.

- the Ling Hun Project team.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

notes.title: Demo Avaliable & Updates
notes.content:
[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/e170bb18ff522dee55614cce3f07d34dfba83c45.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/d8bff02654fa6ca5e1e776fc45eb1b613e5ead01.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/9047003abf2a42f28e321f48fcf151fbcf31e4d2.png[/center]


Hello fellow jumpers!

We have been releasing a lot of Updates since launch. We are a really small group of developers (we are 3 and most of the time it's just me.) so we are putting a lot of effort on making Ling Hun as good, smooth and polished as it ever can be. We hope this is closer and closer from every Update we release. But if that's not the case, we'd love to get some feedback! Remember you can do it just "here" in the comments or in the game community site on Steam and if that's not enought, here you can send something more "personal": linghungame@gmail.com

[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/e170bb18ff522dee55614cce3f07d34dfba83c45.png[/center]

Besides that, we, as always, have updates to talk about. So here they are:

- Fixed a few bad translations for German. ("exit" and the map corner legend).
           (If you are interested in give some feedback for your mother tongue translations we appreciate it.)
- Fixed an issue with the lenguage selection that was not being saved once you closed the game.
  Now your choosen lenguage will remain the same throught game sessions.
- Fixed (at last) the achievements that were not being detected accurately. 
- Corrected the requirements for the Platinum achievement and now it should be acquired once you've 
  got the rest of achievements and not before.
- Fixed a malfunction on 2-5 with some spikes. (if the error persist contact us please.).
- Fixed an error with the resolution options that was making it not work properly before entering the 
  game.
- Fixed an issue in the Settings menu, the volumes were not responding correctly and were allocated 
  incorrectly.


As always, we appreciate all feedback that you can give. And we would like to THANK every single of you that is enjoying the game and give us so much feedback and help us make Ling Hun the best it can be.
Thank you!

[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/e170bb18ff522dee55614cce3f07d34dfba83c45.png[/center]

And now, the other part of this update and good news.

We are releasing a Demo! yay! so that means everyone will be able to check what they will be able to feel in Ling Hun and maybe try to help Yun to catch the imp fox!

[center]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/e170bb18ff522dee55614cce3f07d34dfba83c45.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/c74dd7e91eef67157f729b0764f7c0a36f054a53.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/9047003abf2a42f28e321f48fcf151fbcf31e4d2.png[/center]

Thanks to all of you again for making Ling Hun better and better.

- Ling Hun Project TEAM.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

notes.title: Big Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/d1d2fe57f74d5e22d00cdc6bf3c6dd34b3e30b72.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

Hello Fellow Jumpers!

We are so excited to anounce that we are working hard on polishing the game so everyone can enjoy it at it's fullest. So, without a furthere ado...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

UPDATE:

- Fixed minor issues in some levels involving vines.
- Improved what it seemed the "worst" level in the game. Jokes aside, we did change the top part of the level 6-2 to make it more fair and doable.
- Fixed an issue with one specific menu that was not working as intended so you could not go back.
- Fixed a misspelling on a Steam Achievement.
- Fixed a missing Tile in 4-4.
- Fixed a save spot in 4-2 that was not intended. 
- Fixed a ground tile without collision in the tutorial of zone 6.
- Adjusted some SFX's to be heard much clearer.
- Improved last level visuals for "safe trails" that show a safe path and improved visuals in the transition from outside of the Fox cave to inside, (before the transition of the image was so abrupt and cluncky),
- Improved Sound managment.

Now, some BIG changes and NEWS:

- We made the collectibles more meaningful. So, now, if you got all the collectibles you will get an Achievment.  But that's not all...  a NEW extra level will be opened for you and with that comes two new Achievements;
          - Succeed on the extra level.
          - Succeed on the extra level with 0 deaths.

Talking about Achievments;

- Achievements that were not working are supposed to work now (if not, we'll be working on it asap).
- Changed some Achievements:
          - Now instead of 10.000 jumps you'll need 4.500 jumps (we considered to lower the number 
             after some awesome feedback).
          - Now instead of 10.000 deaths you'll just need 500 (again, thanks to the feedback recieved)
          - To maintain the number of achievements for death count we added a new one for 10 deaths to           
             make the increase smooth and relevant. So the 100 deaths still remains the same.
  
And, last but not least we'd like to showcase a change that we did towards an incredible player that has been giving us feedback and being so nice to point out things for us. So we wanted to show the gratitude with this small but full of love action:

We added a 100% Achievement for the game that goes like that:

Madness Platinum:
Like Our first Platinum Player "MkayShock Madness" you did a huge jump and succeed! Thank YOU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/b4517be428c3e94e0535836309156eeacbcfa9f3.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/291e89ac373db2705d0f1c04f73e558e2d0a2fed.png

And for the rest of you, that play the game, that give us feedback and help us make Ling Hun a better game. THANK YOU SO MUCH!!

- Ling Hun Project Team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/d1d2fe57f74d5e22d00cdc6bf3c6dd34b3e30b72.png

notes.title: Update fixing Problems & Improvements.
notes.content:
Today we updated the game with some fixes and some improvements:

- Fixed an issue on the last level that was trapping you near the Fox.
- Fixed an issue on the zone 5 that was triggering some animations not intended to be triggered.
- Fixed an issue with the Steam Achievements. (Now they work properly and activate properly although not in game overlay yet.)
- Improved some levels to make them more adecuated to the difficulty required.
- Changed font for all the game so now it's all the same.

We are looking to improve even more as soon as we can.

Anything that YOU want to give us feedback on, is goint ot be very appreciated and you can do so at linghungame@gmail.com 

Thank you so much!

Have a nice Jumping day!
- Ling Hun Project Team.

notes.title: Release Update!
notes.content:
We fixed some issues for the Release:

-Fixed an issue with menu visuals using Kayboard/Mouse and Gamepad.
-Fixed an issue on the last level regarding visual cues and camera movement not being adecuate.
-Fixed an issue with a specific menu that was not able to navigate with Gamepad.
-Fixed an issue with FPS and holding buttons to skip some cutscenes and tutorials.

notes.title: Ling Hun Release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/d801b08fba5ed1eab57b860ee0f1959801522b6c.png

[center]Ling Hun Release![/center]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

Hello fellow gamers, today is about you!
Now that Ling Hun is avaliable we want to show that we want to keep working on the game to make it as good as possible. So we are open to hear your feedback.
And for that you can send emails to linghungame@gmail.com or here, in the Steam community you can comment anything and we will be checking every single comment to make sure you are being heard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

Also we want to point out a few updates that are about to come and some that happened already;

Updates Done:


New Screenshots on the store page more actual.
Fixed an issue with menus that was showing buttons on hover while navigating with gamepad.
Fixed issues with the final level which was not showing visual cues correctly for some cages.
Fixed some level malfunctions.
Implemented new backgrounds on every level to match aesthetics.


Updates to come:


Full integration with Gamepad.
Fix future problems that may come listening to the community.
Fix dispairing Fonts.
Release an Artbook for free for those who purchased the game.
Release a BSO for those who like Ling Hun's music.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

We are so open to hear from everyone!

By the way...
Happy Chinese New Year!
新年快乐

notes.title: New Animated Intro and what's to come in Ling Hun.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/b05d6e82f954304cdd88399010c07785e108da75.png

New Update:

We have a new animated video where we can see what happened to Yun and why gravity doesn't affect her jumping at all.
Well, that's the result of having your soul stolen by a capricious and playful fox...

Enjoy this beautiful introduction to Yun's story handmade by our charming artist .

[previewyoutube=DUPi7YgfX-g;full]https://youtu.be/DUPi7YgfX-g?si=u1RYYdBYtgIlZXPl[/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

What's to come:

We want to make you more involved in the development of our game and that is why we believe that sharing what we are working on and what we want to implement as we can brings us closer to you.
Remember that you can always comment in the community, make suggestions and give your opinion since it is VERY important to us!

What are we working on right now?

We are organizing the entire UI to make it comfortable and understandable.
Polishing some levels to make them more interesting and satisfying.
Implementing the Intro and the end of the game.
Implementing a remapping of the controls to make it more accessible.


What comes next?

Make a Demo so you can try Ling Hun.
Polish details that may have escaped the launch.
Implement some Accessibility features.
Release an Artbook for free for everyone who buys or has bought Ling Hun.
Improve and patch as necessary after release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44757853/58e3049b0cedb0a5ee6bf4ede6d30cf78239686f.png

Thank you, as always, for your support!

- "LING HUN PROJECT".
